ENDRELEASENOTES

data.title: perf(build): only look for the Python interpreter in DD4hepConfig
data.author: chrisburr
data.body:
I've been looking at speeding up the cmake configuration time in LHCb and I found that `FIND_PACKAGE(Python)` was being called many times. This ends up being slow due to `python-config` being called several time and the build we use of Python has a high startup overhead.

Unless DD4hep was built with Geant4 there is no need to look for the `Development` components.

This ends up saving ~1.5 seconds on the builds I was benchmarking with:

|       | Baseline      | Patched       |
|-------|---------------|---------------|
| Rec   | 18.8 / 16.4 s | 15.1 / 15.2 s |
| Moore | 17.0 / 16.1 s | 14.2 / 14.7 s |


BEGINRELEASENOTES

- DD4hepConfig: look only for the Python interpreter when DD4hep was built without Geant4 (and not the development component)

ENDRELEASENOTES

data.title: Include IAssignmentFinder.hpp from its new location
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES

- Include `Acts/Material/IAssignmentFinder.hpp` instead of the deprecated `Acts/Material/interface/IAssignmentFinder.hpp`.

ACTS moved `IAssignmentFinder.hpp` out of `Acts/Material/interface/`, and the old path is now only a stub with `#warning "Deprecated, use Acts/Material/IAssignmentFinder.hpp"`. The MuColl image job builds with `-Werror` but without `-Wno-error=cpp`, so this warning fails the build of `MaterialValidationAlg.cpp` (via `GeantinoMaterialAssigner.h`). It currently fails this way on main and on every open PR, e.g. #143 and #144. The new header is in the ACTS of LCG devkey-head and of the MuColl image.
